subtitle: By line of therapy and patient sex

first.detail: Strongest evidence; preferred initial therapy. Counsel on 4-6 month time-to-response.

second.detail: 5α-reductase inhibitor. Counsel on sexual side effects (rare, often resolve on discontinuation).
